expectations.text: Compensating controls: require a legitimate documented technical/business constraint, must meet the intent and be 'above and beyond' other requirements, documented in a compensating controls worksheet, reviewed by the assessor annually
expectations.evidence: "documented, legitimate technical or business constraints"; "meeting the intent and rigor of the original requirement"; "Compensating Controls Worksheet"; "re-evaluated and re-documented at every assessment cycle" (above-and-beyond not verbatim but validity criteria substantively covered)

expectations.text: Customized approach: the v4 formal alternative — meets the stated Customized Approach Objective a different way, requires a documented targeted risk analysis (12.3.2) and assessor-designed testing
expectations.evidence: "design and implement your own control that meets the stated 'Customized Approach Objective'"; "Requires a formal, documented risk analysis for each customized control"; "the assessor has to develop testing procedures specific to your custom control"

expectations.text: States the customized approach requires a full assessment (ROC with a qualified assessor) — not available via most SAQs
expectations.evidence: Never states the customized approach requires a full ROC assessment / is unavailable via most SAQs; only implies QSA involvement ("engage your QSA early") without stating self-assessment ineligibility

expectations.text: Notes some requirements are ineligible for the customized approach where explicitly stated
expectations.evidence: "Only certain requirements are eligible for customized approach (some are marked as not eligible in the standard)"

expectations.text: Advises choosing based on whether the constraint is temporary (compensating) vs a deliberate long-term alternative design (customized)
expectations.evidence: "If it's a temporary or system-specific limitation, go the compensating controls route... If it's a mature, intentional alternative control design you want to standardize, engage your QSA early about customized approach"
